bullets.text: Southern Railway awaits RDSO clearance to fix the train-platform gap at Adambakkam station, and the office should monitor progress for commuter safety.
The Home Department transferred four police officers, including Pallikaranai Deputy Commissioner Eswaran, and the office should note the administrative changes.
Heavy traffic congestion occurred on Poonamallee Mount Road during Diwali, and the office should coordinate with traffic authorities for better management during festivals.
Passengers at Avadi railway station flagged delays in reconstructing platform 4, and the office should follow up with railway officials to expedite the sanctioned work.
Avadi and Tambaram City Police destroyed over 1.7 tonnes of seized narcotics, and the office should commend the anti-drug enforcement efforts.
Vultr launched a 20 MW AI supercompute cluster in Chennai powered by AMD GPUs, and the office should welcome this major infrastructure investment.
University of Madras approved an MoU with Sutherland Global Services to set up an AI lab, and the office should support academic-industry partnerships.
An individual raised concerns that AI content creation tools erase physical differences, and the office should watch for inclusive digital practices.
